features.text: Exclusive Slide-to-Size technology enables precise customization for optimal fit and support
Advanced dual-cuff design with reinforced posterior stays delivers superior immobilization
Universal design accommodates a wide range of patient sizes while maintaining maximum support
Professional-grade materials ensure durability throughout the recovery process
Strategic compression zones help reduce swelling while maintaining therapeutic immobilization

measurement: The innovative Slide-to-Size system accommodates a wide range of leg sizes. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
